title: Switching location and having no location selected on the Dashboard
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an owner/admin (or any user with the Reports permission) on the build under test; a single workplace is selected.
  2. Two workplaces available in the org, and the ability to have no workplace selected (use the workplace switcher in the header).
custom_steps:
1. Switch the selected workplace in the top navigation and confirm the dashboard reloads its figures for the newly selected workplace.
2. With no workplace selected, confirm the dashboard does not load data.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Switching the selected workplace in the top navigation reloads the dashboard's figures for the newly selected workplace.
  • If no workplace is selected, the dashboard does not load data.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9573 (S1 — Access & Entry Point); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S1; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-E1: “If the user switches the selected workplace in the top navigation, the dashboard reloads its figures for the newly selected workplace.”
  • S1-E2: “If no workplace is selected, the dashboard does not load data.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
